articles.title: A Mysterious Signal From Deep Underground Could Be Dark Matter — or Not
articles.summary: Scientists hunting for dark matter found a strange signal they can't explain yet. It might be the elusive particle, but they're not sure. More data is needed.

articles.title: Want to Make Bolder Choices? Try Breathing Out Longer!
articles.summary: A new study shows that breathing out longer can make you more willing to take risks by changing your brain and heart. It might help with anxiety too.

articles.title: AI Is Now Controlling Fusion Energy — Faster Than Any Human Could
articles.summary: Scientists used AI to control a fusion experiment in milliseconds, faster than humans can react. The AI can predict problems and fix them before they happen.
